canonical_project: Telecentras VDC4 (state data center, Paliepiu g.)
owner: Telecentras (AB Lietuvos radijo ir televizijos centras); builders Agentus + KV Baltic
notes: Second new state DC, on Paliepiu g. 3 (Rasos district) near Vilnius airport; construction 2022 Q4-2024, completion act issued early Sept 2024; as of Oct 2024 could not serve clients pending Government resolution on services/pricing; Tier III certificate now granted (VDC3+VDC4 certified per Telecentras page). ~150 of ~300 combined state-DC racks.
